VBO:0200782.summary: Alert and eager to work with its handler, the Koolie tends to put its herding instinct to practical use. It can gather sheep or cattle, move a group in a chosen direction, or hold stock together while waiting for instructions. Australian breeders have long selected for field performance, with somewhat different lines serving open paddocks, yards and livestock trucks.
VBO:0200782.shortDescription: An alert, handler-focused Australian herder whose instinct is to gather, move or hold livestock as a working team.

sources.title: Koolie Club of Australia: Koolie Fundamentals
sources.evidence: Whole club fundamentals personally read: herding instinct groups stock, moves or holds groups in handler-directed positions; works sheep, cattle and other stock. Sound Temperament seeks balanced, alert/eager, attached and responsive to handler, cooperative teamwork. Field-performance selection over generations emphasized work; open-field, yard and trucking lines can differ. All conformation sections support slightly longer-than-tall muscular balanced frame, moderate stop, pricked/tipped ears, natural hock-reaching relaxed curved tail and close flat coat. Strong intelligence/stamina superlatives, genetic/medical and guaranteed work claims excluded.
